channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Hope for tenants as council commits to repairing its building
item.description: Norwich City Council says its repair work will begin after scaffolding goes up at a building it owns on St Leonards Road.

item.title: Traders struggling to survive as a result of multi-million pound redevelopment
item.description: A major redevelopment in the city has left businesses in Magdalen Street such as Beatnix and Cafe Norwich struggling with parking and footfall.

item.title: Family of man electrocuted by 11,000-volt cable calls for better safety
item.description: The death of a man who was electrocuted by an 11,000-volt electrical cable while training for a half-marathon has prompted an urgent review into safety measures, include Norfolk's electricity provider.

item.title: Family-run salon offering unique services looking to expand
item.description: Terri Harris, owner of DUSK Studio in Taverham, is hoping to expand her team which already has a trained trichologist and curly hair specialist.

item.title: Luxury 'by appointment only' car dealer could set up shop in coastal barn
item.description: An upmarket King's Lynn car dealer which operates by appointment only hopes to move into a barn at Snettisham.

item.title: Council 'monitoring' use of cameras to bring back bans on driving near schools
item.description: Fresh calls have been made for to cameras to be used to bring back bans on driving near Norfolk schools at pick-up and drop-off time.

item.title: Site of former Victorian pub to have commemorative plaques installed
item.description: The nine-home development at the site of the former Earl of Leicester pub in Norwich will have two historical plaques to commemorate the building.

item.title: Owners of city's new 'affordable' vets reveal ambitious plans
item.description: Ioannis Kafkias and Evangelos Kanellos, owners of V for Vets at Broadland Business Park are looking to provide 24/7 care for dogs and cats at the site.

item.title: REVEALED: The Norfolk region where one in four children are obese
item.description: One in four children in Great Yarmouth are obese by the time they leave primary school.

item.title: More wind farms could be built off East coast auction results reveal
item.description: More offshore wind farms could be built off the coast of East Anglia as the results of Contracts for Difference (CfD) Allocation Round 7 (AR7) are revealed.
